newsitem.title: UK: OmniMedia to take charge, sets restructuring.
newsitem.headline: OmniMedia to take charge, sets restructuring.

text.p: Multimedia publisher OmniMedia Plc on Thursday said its 1996 results will include "substantial one-time charges" due to a change in accounting policies.

The company said it is completing a comprehensive restructuring programme to focus its activities on the growth of its CD-ROM, European and U.S. publishing operation in 1997. The restructuring, due to be completed by the end of March, is expected to considerably reduce overheads, OmniMedia said.

Retail sales of CD-ROMs in the second half of the year were below budget, due primarily to late shipments of product in the U.S., but were ahead of sales for both the 1996 first half and the year-ago 1995 period. Sales of multimedia authoring tools in the second half were disappointing, OmniMedia said.

The changes in accounting policies will eliminate goodwill and write off development expenditure as incurred. "This will result in certain substantial one-time charges in the 1996 results and a consequential restatement of the 1995 accounts on a basis consistent with the new policies," OmniMedia said.
